caption: 60-month rolling correlation between NAHB HMI and SPY monthly returns. The sign is stable (82% agreement) but the level hugs zero throughout — and the era battery (pre-GFC, GFC bust, QE era, post-COVID) finds NO significant correlation in ANY era (max |r| = 0.12, min p = 0.31). A stably-null relationship, not a stably-useful one. Shaded bands mark NBER recessions.
